verdict.rationale: GitLab's CI/CD pipelines and agent workflows are defined as code (.gitlab-ci.yml) stored in Git, so they inherit Git's native versioning, diffing, and rollback via merge requests and commit history (gitlab-docs-7, gitlab-docs-19); docs also describe agents operating within human-reviewed MR workflows where teams stay in control (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-18, gitlab-docs-24). However, there is no explicit documentation describing a dedicated 'rollback automation' feature or audit trail specifically for AI agent actions/automations. Missing for 10: explicit docs on reverting/rolling back agent-driven automations or pipeline runs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this rollback workflow works well in practice for AI-driven changes.
